## About

Wissam Ataleh is a Senior DevOps & Site Reliability Engineer based in Amman, Jordan. Expert in Kubernetes, site reliability engineering, cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, on-premises), GitOps, MLOps, and zero-trust security. Experience spans ride-hailing scale (Careem), AI research (BeyondAI / Beyond Limits), and open-source civil society (Jordan Open Source Association).

## Experience

- **Senior Site Reliability Engineer II, Careem** (Sep 2024 — May 2026, Amman, Jordan): Architected the "Placement Operator", a custom Go Kubernetes controller automating pod placement and PDB-aware workload rotation across 14 clusters and hundreds of services with zero downtime; optimized multi-cluster AWS with Terraform; defined SLI/SLO metrics and incident management; standardized multi-cluster deployments with GitHub Actions and ArgoCD.
- **Senior DevOps Engineer, BeyondAI (Beyond Limits)** (Oct 2021 — Sep 2024, Glendale, CA / Remote): Provisioned production Kubernetes clusters across private on-premises and hybrid clouds including NVIDIA GPU nodes; built MLOps infrastructure with Kubeflow, MLflow, and KServe; launched confidential-compute environments with Intel SGX and Gramine; implemented end-to-end observability with Prometheus, Grafana, and Loki.
- **DevOps Engineer, Jordan Open Source Association** (Sep 2019 — Oct 2021, Amman, Jordan): Designed self-managed high-availability Kubernetes cloud hosting internal tools, mail, SSO, and CI/CD; led teams building the organization's main web applications and digital safety portals.

## Skills

Cloud & on-premise (AWS, Kubernetes, EKS, Azure AKS, bare-metal K8s, Rancher), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, Helm, Kustomize), Observability (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Loki, ELK, Dynatrace), Security (HashiCorp Vault, Keycloak, RBAC, Trivy, Kyverno, network policies, SOC 2), CI/CD & GitOps (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, ArgoCD, FluxCD), Development (Go, Python, Bash, JavaScript), MLOps & auto-scaling (KEDA, Kubeflow, MLflow, KServe), AI tooling (LLMs, Ollama, LM Studio, SLO/SLI, incident management).

## Key Projects

- **Placement Operator**: Production-grade Go Kubernetes controller for declarative pod placement, node-pool consolidation, and PDB-aware rotation across 14 EKS clusters (Careem).
- **HashiCorp Vault Secrets Platform**: HA Vault across 3 AWS AZs with KMS auto-unsealing and SAML + K8s Service Account auth; eliminated static secrets.
- **Multi-Environment GitOps (ArgoCD)**: Replaced Jenkins scripts with declarative ArgoCD pipelines across Dev/QA/UAT/Prod.
- **MLOps Platform on EKS**: Kubeflow + MLflow platform for model training and deployment.
- **Confidential Compute (Intel SGX)**: Encrypted-memory enclaves with Gramine on Azure and on-premises for PII and AI workloads.
- **JOSA Cloud Initiative**: Open-source Kubernetes cloud hosting Keycloak, Mailu, Nextcloud, Jitsi, and more (JOSA).
